selection_policy: Model and post-processing were chosen on the public DFL matches (leave-one-match-out) and checked on two Metrica sample games. No labels or tuning from the competition match or its public 5 minutes.
note: All thresholds and their sources live in src/config.py (CONFIG['smooth_choice'], CONFIG['final']). The exact values used in a run are copied into run_manifest.json.
